acceptance: With contract_gate=shadow a bound self-check WARNs on a contract violation and exits 0, as the host approves
With report_size_gate=enforce an oversized Handoff Summary fails the self-check as it fails the host
The probe never writes the breaker or salvages
fix: Extract a pure severity projection from deliverable.Reviewer (stage, report-size gate, breaker read-only) that Review uses, inject the root's resolved gate settings into BuildSelfCheck the way the floor is injected, and report each violation at that severity.
summary: phasecmd.BuildSelfCheck blocks on every contract violation and never runs the handoff report-size check. The host gate (deliverable.Reviewer) blocks only at contract_gate=enforce and while its breaker has not demoted it, and blocks oversized handoffs at report_size_gate=enforce. Under the default dials the outcomes match; under other dials the probe is stricter or weaker than the host (ADR-0117 decision 9).
title: The build self-check's contract half reports at the host contract gate's live severity (contract_gate stage, breaker demotion, report_size_gate)
